work.originalTitle: 맥스큐 디지털화보집 Secret B Vol.6 백성혜
work.summary: Digital MAXQ Secret B photobook featuring Korean influencer Baek Seonghye (백성혜). Aladin's e-book catalogue identifies the exact Vol. 6 title as a MAXQ International PDF from 2020-11. Page count, ISBN, and exact release day were not verified. This is a distinct numbered retail product from Baek's later Vol. 16 and physical No. 3; image overlap has not been checked. No cover or paid PDF was copied because reuse permission is unconfirmed.
